captions.caption: A Chinook helicopter flies through a thick, dusty haze.
The helicopter continues its flight in the overcast, dusty sky.
A Chinook helicopter descends towards the ground, kicking up dust.
The helicopter is nearly obscured by a massive cloud of swirling dust.
Dust continues to churn around the aircraft as it lands.
Another Chinook helicopter is seen in flight from a nearby aircraft.
The helicopter flies over a brown, arid landscape.
A view from inside shows the helicopter flying through the dust.
A soldier in a military uniform speaks during an interview.
The soldier continues talking with the helicopter interior behind him.
The soldier finishes his sentence during the interview.
Close-up of a soldier wearing a flight helmet and dark visor.
The soldier in the flight helmet looks down at his equipment.
A soldier's gloved hands adjust a metal latch on the floor.
Close-up of hands working on the helicopter's cargo rail system.
A soldier kneels and works on the cargo rollers on the floor.
The soldier continues to prepare the aircraft's interior for cargo.
View from inside looking out the open rear ramp at cargo.
Cargo pallets are visible at the edge of the helicopter ramp.
A soldier in a flight helmet looks out from the side of the aircraft.
The soldier smiles while observing the view from the helicopter.
A soldier with a flight helmet and headset looks out.
The soldier smiles while looking out of the aircraft.
A young soldier with glasses and a headset smiles at the camera.
The soldier with glasses laughs during his interview.
The soldier continues to talk and smile during the interview.
The soldier with glasses finishes his thought for the camera.
The soldier with glasses speaks about his role in the helicopter.
The soldier finishes his interview segment.
A soldier sits on the open rear ramp of the helicopter.
Silhouette of the soldier on the ramp looking out at the landscape.
The soldier on the ramp continues to watch the area below.
Close-up of the soldier's helmet and visor as he looks down.
The soldier monitors the terrain from his position on the ramp.
The soldier continues to look down at the passing landscape.
A rifle is held by the soldier sitting on the ramp.
View of the dusty ground from the perspective of the open ramp.
The camera pans across the arid landscape from the air.
A soldier sits securely on the edge of the ramp with a rifle.
The soldier looks out over the mountains from the moving aircraft.
Aerial view of the rugged, dry mountain ranges.
The landscape features jagged peaks and deep valleys.
Continued aerial shot of the brown, dusty mountains.
The camera moves across the rugged mountain landscape.
Wide shot of the vast desert and mountains.
The mountain peaks are seen against a clear blue sky.
The helicopter flies over a vast, brown mountain range.
A green patch of vegetation is visible in a valley below.
The helicopter flies over cultivated fields in the desert valley.
Lush green fields contrast with the surrounding arid land.
The aerial view shows the layout of the buildings in the valley.
The helicopter moves over the settlement in the valley.
A soldier on the ramp looks down at the green valley.
The camera captures the soldier's perspective from the open ramp.
A soldier sits on the ramp with a rifle across his lap.
The soldier continues to monitor the ground from the ramp.
View of the soldier's boots dangling over the edge of the ramp.
The boots are seen against the backdrop of the green fields.
The camera focuses on the boots and the ground far beneath.
A soldier in a flight helmet looks down from inside the aircraft.
